title: dnevnik.live Seed RWA metadata (v1.0.0)
description: Metadata schema for dnevnik.live seed NFTs (M2). Extends the Metaplex non-fungible token standard with a structured `rwa` block describing the physical seed. Metadata JSON is uploaded to Arweave (via Irys) and referenced by the on-chain token metadata URI.

name.description: Display name of the seed NFT (Metaplex on-chain limit: 32 chars).

external_url.description: Link to the dnevnik.live grow journal, with ?plant=<plantId> when linked.

attributes.description: Wallet-visible traits. Always includes Strain, Batch, Stage, Network, Imported; Plant ID when linked.

rwa.description: Machine-readable real-world-asset record for the physical seed.

strain.description: Cultivar / strain name of the seed.

batch.description: Physical batch code the seed belongs to.

plantId.description: dnevnik.live plant ID this seed is linked to in the grow journal (null until planted).
